summary: Regression validation for the POS dedicated Motor pool + maxTimeMS analytics fix. 16/16 backend tests PASSED in ~9s. POS critical path (customer check, earn, idempotency, redeem/OTP envelope) works correctly on the new pos_* collection handles. All 7 capped report/dashboard endpoints (sales-trend, store-performance, top-skus, kpis, city-performance, store-wise-kpi, weekly-kpi) return 200 well under 30s with no MaxTimeMSExpired. Segment audience export streams CSV with 50+ customer rows via the long_col bounded pool. No 5xx regressions on sampled analytics endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: Pool split is clean: pos_ewards_routes.py aliases pos_* handles to the same local names (customers_col, transactions_col, etc.), so the endpoint logic remained untouched — only the underlying socket pool changed. This is the correct minimally-invasive shape for a P0 hotfix.

maxTimeMS=25000 caps are applied at the aggregation call site (not via a wrapper), which is the right place. Under normal preview load all 7 capped endpoints returned <2s; the cap will only surface in the pathological runaway case it is designed to prevent.

posAddPoint idempotency correctly returns a 400 duplicate-bill envelope on retry for a fully-committed bill and a 200 'resumed' envelope for a partial-commit — verified balance did not double-credit on repeat submission.

The critical POS billing path (posCustomerCheck, posAddPoint, posRedeem*) runs on the dedicated _pos_client pool and the 7 previously-uncapped report aggregations now carry maxTimeMS=25000. All 16 assertions pass. If POS 'Loyalty is not Active' reappears, first check pos_ewards_routes.py imports still resolve to pos_db handles from database.py and check backend logs for pymongo.errors.NetworkTimeout on the shared client (which would indicate a new endpoint accidentally using the wrong pool).
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration was regression validation only; the RCA (shared Motor pool starvation by uncapped analytics aggregations starving POS billing) was already root-caused and fixed by the main agent. This test confirms the fix holds under a functional smoke suite.
